sentences.en: The hospital has a new system to track the progress of its inpatients.
sentences.zh: 医院有一个新系统来追踪住院病人的进展。

sentences.en: She was admitted as an inpatient and stayed for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 她作为住院病人被收治了两周。

sentences.en: The nurse checked on the inpatients every hour to monitor their conditions.
sentences.zh: 护士每小时检查一次住院病人的状况以监测他们的病情。
